page.notes: The first word of the page is a fragment ("viui") and its first letter is unclear. "Devolve" is read from "Deuolue", "vivere"/"vivificavit" from "viuere"/"viuificauit", applying the u/v rule. The word before "cum semine" reads "femine" in print; it is read as "semine" (long s) and may be uncertain. "Quare electurus es" has a stray mark between "Quar" and "e"; read as "Quare". The reference bullet in "loc● 14." is printed as is. The left-margin numbers at the far edge of the scan belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed. The Philippians verse continues on the next page; "boni" is the catchword.
